The idea

Every machine runs at 100 %; only the number of machines of each recipe changes. Fluids and unusable products must come out exactly even, and the Phase 5 parts in exact proportion if that box is ticked. The machine counts that satisfy those equations form an integer lattice. Its reduced basis is a set of moves: bundles such as “+2 of this, −1 of that” that keep every exact balance exact. The page only ever changes the factory by moves, so it cannot become unbalanced.

A move can still make something go negative: a machine count, a building material that is used faster than it is made, or a raw resource that would be produced instead of drawn. Such moves are greyed out. Raw resources and power are not limited here.

Phase 5 batches

With whole machines at 100 % and the exact Phase 5 ratio, Phase 5 can only be made in whole batches: the smallest set of machine counts that balances every intermediate exactly. The batch depends on the recipes in use (and on the valves). The factory is sized to the number of batches you pick: the plan's recipe ratios are scaled to that output and snapped to the nearest valid whole-machine factory. Untick the ratio box to treat the Phase 5 parts like other surplus items, with minimums you set on the Items tab.

Reading the numbers

  • Step is the smallest change in a recipe's machine count that any combination of moves can make. A big step is a chain of exact ratios that only works in large batches; a valve (Items tab) or a different recipe usually shrinks it.
  • Shrink this searches combinations of up to three moves (each used once or twice) for the one that lowers the selected recipe the most and keeps everything valid, preferring fewer machines in all. Phase 5 output and the minimums on the Items tab are kept.
  • Changing a valve, the recipe list or the number of batches rebuilds the moves and snaps to the nearest valid factory.

The lattice is exact (big-integer column reduction, then Lenstra–Lenstra–Lovász reduction). Recipe data is the production sheet's. Import takes production-sheet exports, optimizer plans and recipe-matrix exports; export gives a production-sheet file.
